notes.title: Modern farming!
notes.content:
[h2][b]Hey Daomei Villagers! 🌾[/b][/h2]

[h3]Welcome to another devlog from our beloved Daomei Village! Today, we're going to talk about new, exciting farming possibilities we're introducing to the game. We know that crops are crucial – after all, we need to pay the tax collector, right? 💸 But don’t worry, we have some cool updates that will make growing plants even more fun and efficient![/h3]

In previous devlogs, we talked about classic f[b]arming – watering with a can, growing outdoors, and so on. Now it's time for something extra!
[/b]


[h3][b]🔧 AUTOMATIC WATERING[/b][/h3]
Don't feel like running around with a watering can? We’ve got you covered! You can now invest in automatic watering systems. Available in three sizes: 3x3, 5x5, and 7x7. You can craft them in the workshop using resources. Once set up, your plants will be watered regularly without any effort from you! 🌱

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41839711/848e56f87bb57428e019b365591bd14b5988f993.png[/img]


[h3][b]🌿 GREENHOUSES[/b][/h3]
Want to protect your crops from unpredictable weather and pests? Introduce greenhouses! Here too, you have three sizes to choose from: 3x3, 5x5, and 7x7, crafted in the workshop. Greenhouses provide 100% protection from the wind and reduce the chances of diseases and pests by 50%. 🌦️🦗

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41839711/5f1dae24ebbc7821f14db9da966d9ba81d8308ac.png[/img]


[h3][b]🔄 COMBINE AND CONQUER[/b][/h3]
And the best part? You can combine automatic watering and greenhouses on a single plot! Maximum protection with minimal effort. The perfect combination for any farmer looking to optimize their harvests and focus on other aspects of life in Daomei Village. 🌟


[h3]
We can't wait for you to see these new features in action! Let us know what you think and what other features you’d like to see in the game. Your feedback is incredibly valuable to us![/h3]

Thanks for being with us and have a great time in Daomei Village! 🌾❤️


[url=https://discord.gg/ujMc55FHqY][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41839711/0d8767188c38fa90082f359aff504adfbe0d7345.png[/img][/url]



See you soon,
The Daomei Village Team

notes.title: Daomei village inhabitants pt.2
notes.content:
[h1][b]Hello fellow villagers! 👋[/b][/h1]

A few devlogs ago we’ve introduced some of the inhabitants of our Daomei Village to you. You were interested in hearing about them so today we’ve invited some more to introduce themselves and share their stories! 💬

[h3][b]🏹 Qiqiang and Wushi 🐶[/b][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41839711/96cb38fa90cacf8fa162ad215ca8aa3b62ebb114.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41839711/f33bb7e9e21384a8c056c89b1623c63ea2f36b1c.png[/img]
Archery used to be a virtue of all the Chinese Emperors and they enjoyed spending their time hunting. This brings us to the first person living in our village- [b]Qiqiang[/b], the former [b]Chief Hunter of the royal palace[/b]. Was achieving this feat all his own effort or help from his father, he’s not sure. The fact is, there was not a single person able to match his archery skills. 

You may wonder, how could such a talented person end up exiled… One day the order came for Qiqiang to hunt wild birds for the upcoming feast. While embarking on the hunt he saw the girl he was in love with- [b]Hongyan[/b] talking and laughing sweetly with the palace cook. This sight filled Qiqiang’s heart with hatred. His clouded mind made him unable to land a single shot and brought the Emperor's wrath upon him. The Emperor though gave him one more chance to redeem himself.

Finally, the day has come- to prove his bow mastery he was ordered to shoot down the apple placed on the head of the servant. His mind though was filled with the images of how happy Hongyan was talking with the other man. This made him miss the aim and shoot down the Mianliu Guan from the top of the Emperor's head, revealing the bald spot it was hiding. This feat sealed the fate and exilement of Qiqiang.

[b]Wushi[/b] on the other hand is Qiqiang’s best friend and irreplaceable partner- a greyhound. He’s great at tracking prey and their cooperation is seamless. His presence brings more life and joy to the village of Daomei.


[h3][b]💭 Ping[/b][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41839711/c5624183d8bb4fa27db76d28b4e917667beb2fda.png[/img]
Mr. Ping- once a trusted counselor of the Emperor made a single mistake but it was enough to share the fate of Qiqiang. Smith Ping has not always worked in the workshop. Although he started learning the craft from early childhood, his ambition and great intellect led him all the way to the tax office. 

It all started during the national exam. He ended up passing with the best grades and got hired in the office where he met his future wife- [b]Daiyu[/b]. She was the daughter of the chief official. In no time Ping got promoted over and over again all the way to the manager of the palace treasury. He had free access to the Emperor, being given audiences even when no other person could’ve been granted one.

Finally that cursed day came… As usual Ping had an audience with the Emperor during his majesty’s breakfast. He was even offered a cup of green tea and a bowl of rice which he gratefully accepted. There was no sign of what was about to come. While eating, a small fly landed on his nose making him sneeze. 

The entire court fell silent. Unfortunately, Ping was chewing rice, making him spit the rice all over the Emperor. His rage was immeasurable. He was cursing the poor Ping and exiled him. Ping has never run so quickly in his life. He only took his small daughter [b]Xiulan[/b], wife and some items before fleeing to the Daomei village.


[h3][b]📐 Honghui[/b][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41839711/4efaa285ffcc75a4204caef9fc7777cb679532fd.png[/img]
The best engineer in the entire country. A person of many talents- engineering, constructing, architecture, he’s even an impressive inventor. His everyday duties were to assure the comfort of living for the Emperor. Part of his job was also ordering the repairs around the palace as well as improving the building. Although his true potential laid in his ability to invent ingenious appliances, the Emperor made him do projects he found boring and not challenging at all.

One time instead of an agreement to test his new device he received an order to build another bridge over the brook in Emperor’s garden. Discouraged, he didn’t put much thought and effort in the design which resulted in the Emperor falling into the water, wetting his favorite silk slippers. Cold sweat covered Honghui’s cold face, when the Emperor shouted the order to cast the traitor out of the palace. In no time he got banished to live in the Daomei village.

Nowadays, after his exilement, he has enough free time to focus on building a machine that produces his most favorite dish- baozi. The new environment he found himself in brought an unexpected change of heart. [b]Xianmei[/b] a zither playing virtuoso captivated his heart with her music. This made Honghui work even harder to be able to treat Xianmei to something tasty. He finds his feelings for Xianmei an obstacle in his work but he can’t help but want to get closer to her once the machine is done.

What he doesn’t know is that because of all the noise coming from his house, she’s trying to avoid him, considering him uncultural. Will their feelings ever become mutual? You’ll have to find out for yourself!


[h3][b]🌺 Qiang[/b][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41839711/aec943c6208307035e390ad1c84e9eb14bb9949f.png[/img]
Daughter of the most prominent florist family. She’s the third generation responsible for maintaining the Emperor’s garden. It all started with her grandfather, who raised the most beautiful rose to celebrate the visit of the Emperor in his village. It’s worth mentioning it wasn’t the hibiscus, often called chinese rose but an actual rose.

Captivated by the flower’s beauty, the Emperor invited him to become the royal gardener. It was at this moment that flowers became Qiang’s family’s entire world. 

Hearing this amazing story many times in her life, Qiang wanted to surpass her grandfather and show her skills to the Emperor. She decided to raise a rose as a gift for the Emperor's upcoming birthday. It couldn’t be any rose, if she was to accomplish this feat the flower she raised had to be both the most beautiful and the most beautifully smelling. When the day came, she was ready to present her masterpiece- the Heavenly Rose. Unfortunately, she didn’t remove the thorns and once the Emperor poked his finger with one, he fainted at the sight of blood.

After bringing disgrace to her family’s tradition. Qiang decided to protect her beloved family members and decided to flee the city and bring all the shame with her. That finally brought her all the way to Daomei village. Despite everything that happened, she never stopped loving flowers and her house and garden are real pieces of art. She is often seen sitting on the bench in front of her house admiring the plants. You can always visit her and buy some flower seeds, she’ll gladly share!


[h3][b]🎶 Xianmei[/b][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41839711/97269add2d86edb5d07d9e1af14ecc959ee291b8.png[/img]
As we’ve already mentioned, her guzheng zither playing skills are unparalleled. She was born in a humble village and to learn how to play zither she had to travel through dangerous forest on a daily basis, just to be able to attend the lessons. 

She was determined to succeed because of the stories she heard about how knowing how to play can provide for her and her family. In no time Xianmei’s genius made her climb to the top of the music world and her Master recommended her for the position of the Emperor’s musician. Many tried to face her and just that many had to forfeit in front of her talent and guzheng mastery. 

She felt she’s living her dream until that one day that changed everything… The Emperor ordered Xianmei to perform his favorite song. She immediately started performing but at some point she made a mistake and an incorrect note crawled into her otherwise impeccable performance. This was enough to bring the Emperor’s wrath upon her. He doesn’t need a musician who can’t even perform his most favorite song perfectly. She was exiled and the Daomei village became her new home. 

Her life is peaceful, filled with guzheng music which you can hear while passing by her home. She’s probably the only person in the entire village not irritated by [b]Enlai[/b]’s creations about the Moon. After all the music was inextricably linked to the cosmos and Moon is part of it. Her house stands next to Honghui’s, which makes her irritated because of all the noises coming from his home.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41839711/f037f94f2db91f5b8db2873c9db93028538fb373.png[/img]
[h3]Every person in Daomei Village has some kind of story, it’s only up to you to decide if you’ll let the people open up and share them with you. If you found the devlog interesting you can join our discord community to get notified about every upcoming information! Who’s your favorite character? Do you think Xianmei and Honghui will fall in love with each other? Let us know in the comments![/h3]

[url=https://discord.gg/ujMc55FHqY][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41839711/0d8767188c38fa90082f359aff504adfbe0d7345.png[/img][/url]

See you soon,
Daomei Village Team

notes.title: Day and night
notes.content:
[h1][b]Hello Fellow Villagers! 👋[/b][/h1]

Welcome back to our humble Daomei Village. We’re happy to see you back after a while and today we’d like to talk about an important part of the daily activities of everyone around here. Today, we’ll talk about [b]☀️day & night🌑 cycle[/b]!

[previewyoutube=c4jYX1saBI8;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3]In our village, different opportunities and possibilities come at different times but they also impose certain rules we’d like you to follow. With that being said, let’s give you some examples! 📝[/h3]

[b]During the day, you’ll be able to complete quests and assignments, craft items, explore the areas relatively safely or focus on the agricultural aspect of the gameplay[/b]. Every evening though, you’ll be expected to come back to your hut for the night. 🛌

You’ll be able to come back by yourself after finishing your duties or get forcefully moved once you reach a certain hour outside. ⌚

[b]In the evenings you’ll be able to find some extraordinary items you wouldn’t be able to come across during the day like different species of bugs and mushrooms. 🍄[/b] So make sure to look out for them during your nightly escapades. 

[h3]We’ve also prepared many items which could come in handy to save some time like the potions of quickness. ⚗️ You should definitely think of using them to get the most value out of every single night! 💪[/h3]

[b]Every morning you’ll receive a summary of the previous day as well as some information: current weather, crop damages etc.[/b]

That’s it for to… Oh wait… 😢 Sometimes the tax collector will also appear in the morning. Maybe not opening the door or getting yourself a bigger dog will make him skip your farm. 🤔

With this positive accent we can end today’s short devlog. [b]Don’t forget to join our discord and if you’d like to support us, make sure to add this game to your Steam wishlist! [/b]❤️‍

Daomei Village Team

notes.title: Animals
notes.content:
[h1][b]Hello Players! 👋[/b][/h1]

Welcome back to our humble village. Today, we’d like to take you for a short tour to take a closer look at some of the animals you’ll come across while spending time in Daomei Village. 🐄. Some of them you’ll only meet in the wild, while others will await your return at home.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41839711/4a96dd7c10d1b222bb25ebf2fa6bc17ee3632f53.png[/img]
[h3][b]Farm animals 🐑[/b][/h3]
They’re all the animals you can take care of and house in the special buildings. Given enough care and attention they’ll even be happy to see the player! 💝
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41839711/6ef7f1e5f55771cebcd87b5d95602ceade7740bf.png[/img]

Taking care of the farm animals also serves a different purpose. Feed them well, make sure they always have enough water and a clean home to make sure they provide you with collectible items- the fruits of your work.

-[b]Sheeps, goats, cows and horses [/b] will allow you to collect [b]milk[/b].

-[b]Chickens[/b] are your most reliable source of [b]eggs and feathers[/b].

-[b]Pigs[/b] will provide you with some delicious [b]ham[/b].

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41839711/65879f44eb96f2572c5d10ba221554d4b3d2777d.gif][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41839711/65879f44eb96f2572c5d10ba221554d4b3d2777d.gif[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41839711/c96843a1feee9a3277e1ffa1cb1e71a60cea7873.gif][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41839711/c96843a1feee9a3277e1ffa1cb1e71a60cea7873.gif[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41839711/2a1a3e5350a8be2141ee9cd8e8184932ba6b358c.gif][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41839711/2a1a3e5350a8be2141ee9cd8e8184932ba6b358c.gif[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41839711/988ef5389f23810dc23584af4381dbbfe0b329c9.gif][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41839711/988ef5389f23810dc23584af4381dbbfe0b329c9.gif[/img][/url]
[h3][b]Companion animals 🐱[/b][/h3]
Companion animals are also part of your household.They’ll be able to interact with the player. They’ll be happy to see you every time you enter your farm and follow you around. The best examples of such animals are cats and dogs. 🐶 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41839711/95e60df7ac66dfdd59f43857f6137cea2d070a90.png[/img]
On top of that, they’ll also protect your household in your absence to make sure that martens and other aggressive wild animals don’t run around the farm stealing eggs, milk or even chickens.

Don’t forget to give them enough love! You’ll be able to pet and feed them and when your bond is strong enough, they’ll even look around and sometimes bring you a gift! 🤩

[h3][b]Wild animals 🦆[/b][/h3]
Different wild animals will be present on all the maps and you’ll not be able to interact with them. We’re talking about different birds, ducks, squirrels, frogs etc. They’re part of the surrounding nature and as such, should be left to live a peaceful life bringing some extra life and joy to the surrounding terrains. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41839711/7b07aa965392d0ae47e205c572b1459933a743b0.png[/img]
Thank you for being with us today! We’re glad to be able to show you around once again and we can’t wait to hear your opinions on the contents of today’s devlog! As always we’d love to invite you to join our discord community and to wishlist our game on Steam so you don’t miss any future devlogs! 👇

notes.title: Collectible Items
notes.content:
[h1][b]Hello Players 👋[/b][/h1]

How are you doing in this new beautiful year? We’re doing just fine and today we’re back with a new devlog! 🤩 As we’ve already mentioned, outside the village you’ll have plenty of opportunities to interact with your surroundings to acquire items. 🎒 Collecting them will cost you stamina points and some of your findings will be valuable ingredients used in various crafting and cooking recipes. 🥐

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41839711/5478dc95e25aacb7f836e413284b6c0e89823e93.png[/img]
[h2][b]Item division: 📝[/b][/h2]

[h3][b]frequency of appearance[/b][/h3]

There are four rarities of items appearing in our game:

[b]Common[/b]
- The most common type of items
- They have no unique or extraordinary effects

[b]Uncommon[/b]
- they appear less frequently than the common items but they’re still fairly easily available
- they have more value and have some unique effects
- they help to introduce diversity to the gameplay

[b]Rare[/b]
- valuable collectibles with considerably lower chance of appearance
- they present significant upgrades or unique characteristics
- a common goal of player’s search during the quests

[b]Epic/collectable[/b]
- the rarest items in game
- they possess the most outstanding characteristics and collector’s value
- they often make for a final goal or a reward for hard quests

[h3][b]☀️ Day and night cycle 🌑[/b][/h3]

We’ve previously said that our game comes with a day and night cycle. This cycle is a great opportunity to introduce some diversity for your exploration expeditions. In our game we present you an opportunity to look for items only available during the night such as fireflies, fluorescent mushrooms or glowing flowers.

[h3][b]Area [/b][/h3]

During your expeditions you’ll have to pay attention to the areas you explore because different items are possible to find in certain places. After all, you won’t be looking for Chinese Windmill butterflies in the middle of the caves where you could find minerals or ores. 

There are also objects you can search in order to find an item drawn from a predefined pool. One of such objects is a pile of sticks where you can collect different beetles and cones.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41839711/4a304f5b653538094076aaf23db78848809ecb9e.png[/img]

Hope you’ve enjoyed this devlog. As always we’d love to invite you to join our discord community 👇 and if you want to help our game grow, please consider adding it to your wishlist on Steam.

notes.title: Crafting
notes.content:
[h1][b]Hello Players! 👋[/b][/h1]

[h3][b]Welcome back to the humble Daomei Village. You’ve come just in time to learn some things about crafting. 🧰[/b][/h3] 

There are different stations available in our village which you can interact with in order to craft items. At first, you’ll have to use the ones already available in the village but once you progress enough with your crafting mastery you’ll be able to build the proper crafting stations at home.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41839711/9b1596740c6b26a5432ac61f014508593c2cd05b.png[/img]
But before we start crafting, let’s talk about the knowledge you need to get grasp of to be able to create items- [b]recipes[/b]. You can receive them through various activities, some will be waiting for you in the long forgotten chests as rewards for your exploration. Some will be granted to you as quest rewards while others… you’ll simply have to buy. Not every artisan is fond of giving away his secrets for free. 💰

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41839711/cc1cf2aeec104bc243508b6a0f37768a8fe001d9.png[/img]
[h3]Let’s take a quick look at all the stations and what items will you be able to craft there, shall we?[/h3]

[b]Workshop[/b]
Location:
Crafting: buildings and materials required to build.

[b]Tea drying station[/b]
Location: at Fang’s Teashop. 
Crafting: Creating tea mixtures ready for brewing.

[b]Alchemical table[/b]
Location: at Yi’s clinic. 
Crafting: magical potions and mixtures.

[b]Blacksmith furnace[/b]
Location: at blacksmith Peng’s place. 
Crafting: melting ores into bars, smelting metals, creation of semi-finished blacksmith products.

[b]Kitchen[/b]
Location: in the player's house from the beginning of the game.
Crafting: cooking dishes.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41839711/f17766dec5f2171a47888df153fc2cda4d750b4e.png[/img]
We’ll reveal more recipes in the future. We wonder if you have any ideas which traditional chinese dishes will you be able to create in our game? Let us know in the comments! 🤩

[h3]As always, we encourage you to join our discord 👇 and add the game to your wishlists![/h3]

notes.title: Restoring the buildings
notes.content:
[h1][b]Welcome back to our humble Daomei Village! 👋[/b][/h1]

Autumn is a beautiful time in our village. It’s also a good time to take a closer look at the task ahead. 🙂 As you’re well aware, the main in-game goal is to restore the Village and help it regain its former glory. Not of the kindness of your heart though… We know you are just doing it so that the Emperor would acquit you. Not like it matters though, does it? 🤷

[h3][b]There are many buildings in the village, therefore some of them will be possible to upgrade right from the start, while some will require more effort like completing a task.[/b] 📝[/h3]

[b]Buildings like that are discovered through various activities[/b] like talking. 💬 One of such places is [b]Xiaoming’s house[/b]. Engaging in a conversation with her will lead you to learning about the damaged roof over her place and unlocking the option to repair it. 🏠[b] Let’s take a look at all the upgrades her house can go through![/b] 🔨

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41839711/326e2f2999a9152b2dede3737dbaecba1a29dcf9.gif[/img]
[h3][b]In some cases simply inspecting a building or walking by will allow you to start repairing the place. [/b][/h3]

It’s worth mentioning the money 💰 itself won’t be necessarily important to upgrade the houses. You’ll need many items such as boards, nails, metal parts, ropes and roof tiles and of course, [b]the right tools[/b]! ⚒️

Some of them you’ll be able to find during exploration, others you’ll craft while some… Well, let’s just say the people of Daomei are friendly folks who will help you if asked. 👍 

[h3]Keep in mind our goal is to make Daomei Village into a truly breathtaking city. 👀 That’s why some of the buildings will require more work- multiple upgrades allowing them to show their true beauty. 👷[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41839711/b667eb7f09c2fed5f97c89a091a545015724121f.gif[/img]
[h3][b]Once the building is upgraded you’ll receive EXP to spend, we’ll get to that part of the game in the future devlogs![/b][/h3]

By the way, we’ve been wondering… [b]Do you think it would be more motivating to restore the city if there were certain bonuses for fixing certain buildings?[/b] We’re thinking about discounts for upgrading/buying items at the forge after upgrading the blacksmith's house etc. We can’t wait to hear your opinions about it so make sure to let us know in the comments! 🤩

Unfortunately that’s it for today. If you have any ideas, wishes or suggestions about contents of the game join our discord and let us know! 👇 Don’t forget to add Daomei Village to your wishlists, it motivates us to keep working hard!

notes.title: Locations
notes.content:
[h1][b]Hello! 👋[/b][/h1]

[h3]Welcome back to our humble Daomei Village. You’re a newcomer so the villagers thought you might feel lost at first. 🙁 Therefore, they decided to put together a little information bulletin for you with all the important locations. Someone even provided you with some images to visualize the area! Aren’t they really wonderful people? 💝[/h3]

As you already know, [b]Daomei Village is a world fully open for players to explore[/b] (ofc within it’s premises so the Emperor doesn’t sentence you to death) You’ll have a chance to [b]explore, do quests and find all kinds of items[/b] required to progress your development even further! 

Let’s talk about the main areas in the game, shall we?

[h3][b]Daomei Village[/b][/h3]

A small village which is not only[b] a place where many quests await you[/b] but also your main goal as a player. It’s the very village you have to renovate and help thrive in order to be pardoned in the eyes of the Emperor. Besides rebuilding the village, making it look breathtaking and a prosperous trading place are also challenges you’re going to face.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41839711/458a92a0071f6d22ac7e97f6dee66fd3fbeb7921.jpg[/img]
[h3][b]Village vicinity[/b][/h3]

The area around our beautiful Daomei consists of [b]picturesque copses, dense groves 🌳, sunny meadows and peaceful clearings [/b]🌼 offering you [b]unique natural treasures[/b] not available in any other areas such as: wild birds eggs 🥚, wild berries, mushrooms 🍄. Some of the items necessary to complete quests in the village. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41839711/1f5d4ddda4a7678865b3380123c7c53d3ec77212.png[/img]
[h3][b]Player’s house[/b][/h3]

Your house and lands belonging to you take quite a bit of space which is bound to provide you with a lot of comfort while planning and developing your farm. 🗺️ Use the area to your heart’s content, [b]create a farm of your dreams[/b] on which you’ll grow all the necessary plants, raise the animals and more! [b]Careful planning is necessary as this is going to be your main source of income! [/b]👍

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41839711/1c61b87a2f04018d11ad4d1c3fb9c727ba0622ba.jpg[/img]
[h3][b]Caves[/b][/h3]

[b]It’s a dangerous, dark place where treasures (literally) wait to be claimed[/b]. 💰 These caves are shrouded in mystery. Are you willing to face the unspoken dangers for a chance to find extremely rare items? ⚔️ The treasure chests contain [b]crafting recipes[/b] and crafting allows you to [b]upgrade your tools [/b]or [b]create powerful potions![/b] 🤩 Sometimes, you may come across a task requiring you to go and explore this area. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41839711/9ff30d7664545b5fa03951fb677c1fcb287d0741.png[/img]
These are not all the locations available for exploration, one of the locations yet to be presented to you is[b] Port[/b] 🎣 where players will trade their goods with local fishermen. We plan to add many objects and possibilities for players to come across but we’ll talk about this location more in the following devlog 😜

[h3][b]We’d love to hear your opinions about the locations. Is there some specific area you’d like us to add to the game? Let us know in the comments![/b][/h3]

Don’t forget to join our discord community and if you like the contents of the game presented to you thus far, please consider adding our game to your wishlists! 👇

notes.title: Farming
notes.content:
[h1][b]Hello! 👋[/b][/h1]

Welcome to our humble village! In our Daomei, it’s about time to start planting some of the plants some of which our region is well-known for. Would you like to join us? 🤔 Don’t worry, we’ll teach you everything you need to know in order to start your adventure as a beginner farmer in our Daomei Village! 

Let’s start with [b]some basic knowledge.[/b] Take a look at those plants in front of you. As you can see the first 10 are different kinds of tea with the highlight being no.9 [b]The Green Xihu Longjing Tea[/b], followed by hibiscus, jasmine, corn, white, brown and black rice and pear & apple trees.📝

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41839711/7d3ddffd4a50f945e8a40857bee94583486329d3.png[/img]

Keep in mind as a beginner you won’t have access to the more valuable seeds. You’ll have to earn your right to use them! 🧑‍🌾

[h3]Let’s move on to the steps you have to follow in order to have beautiful and bountiful crops, shall we? See that tool in the corner? It’s a hoe. Grab it and take a look at how to properly prepare your fields for the entire process! 👀[/h3] 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41839711/065b4fbb5958e41361afa90666a7570a14a717b3.gif[/img]
[h3]Once you’re done with this part, you can grab the bag with seeds from the table over there and start planting! It's a fairly simple step, nothing complicated! 🌾[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41839711/a39b579172f4e1602deb2dbb397c4584444bfce3.gif[/img]
[h3]Oh, where do you think you’re going, the work is not done yet! Grab the can and water your plants, then you can visit it once a day to check out the progress and water them again. 💦[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41839711/2ec24877db5c592d26cbcf4a2562a6bb5f17611f.gif[/img]
[h3]Take a look over there, there are some plants about to grow to the next stage! 🏃 Come again in a few days to check out how harvesting should be done. 👍[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41839711/d394959f22475d61cc6fd9ad18c63af7f80b328a.gif[/img]
[h3]Oh, you’re finally back! 😁 Let’s get to work. Grab the sickle and follow me! Do your best not to damage the crops, only cut them down, just like that. [/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41839711/18ad5c617f1785de303500b7d47a3542d8af2b69.gif[/img]
As I said, it’s nothing too complicated, you only need to remember to follow those steps. Use this knowledge to become a decent farmer and bring more fame to our region! You can utilize the crops you produce in a few different ways:

[b]- complete the tasks given by the villagers
- produce goods,
- omplete the tasks given by the tax collector (giving you some Emperor’s mercy points),
- or simply feed your farm animals. [/b]

[b]Work diligently because farming is one of the key mechanics which can allow you to regain the trust of the Emperor. The other three are gathering resources, growing animals and fighting the monsters.[/b]

Remember though… Whether you decide to become a farmer or not, you can’t flee the Daomei Village! So better get used to your new life and in the meantime, join our discord community 👇 where you can meet other farmers from the area, and add the game to your wishlists 👇 to not miss on any new Emperor’s decree!

notes.title: DEVLOG #2 | Dialogue System
notes.content:
[h1][b]Hello Players! ⛩️[/b][/h1]

Today we would like to share with you how works one of the most important systems throughout the game - [b] the Dialogue System.[/b]

As you already know, every inhabitant of Daomei Village has committed some sort of offense that angered the Emperor. Also you - the main heroes. Sometimes these were something serious, and sometimes an innocent little mistake caused the Lord to anger overwhelmingly.

The Dialogue System designed by us will allow you to find out for what the inhabitants of Daomei were expelled and for what you ended up there. And that's not all!

[previewyoutube=GUDJ6r73d5o;full][/previewyoutube]

There is a lot going on in this charming, magical, pixelart world of Daomei Village. During conversations and interactions with the townspeople, you may receive a reward, you may be asked to complete a task or walk away with nothing. The paths of choice will allow you to shape the individual character of your own character.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41839711/149c107b6c13592ccff3af3eb5fa40c8f7043633.png[/img]

The whole thing is based on an original creation and story that can be freely explored. You will not find such characters and such stories anywhere else! If you want to get to know the Archer - talk to him. Also talk to Changpu, Xiaoming, Mr. Li and everyone in the Village. It will definitely pay off!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41839711/6f581aea84ab6e088e35d9b2d674c02f2f1e09eb.png[/img]

[h3] [b] Be sure to share your opinion here on Steam, or join our Discord! [/b] [/h3]
[url=https://discord.gg/ujMc55FHqY][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41839711/fa82d0aea3703f175dee3fbc12eb4d8ca80416e4.png[/img][/url]

[h3][b] Don't forget to add Daomei Village to your Steam Wishlist and stay tuned! The villagers are waiting for you! [/b][/h3]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1825030/Daomei_Village/

See you soon,
Daomei Village Team

notes.title: CUSTOMIZATION
notes.content:
[h2]WELCOME! ⛩️[/h2]

Today we would like to show you how the game is developed and what cool features are waiting for you. We are going to slowly reveal to you the most interesting aspects of our project to whet your appetite 😊

Today we will focus on the possibility of customizing our character. At Daomei Village, we want to give you the opportunity to completely empathize with the character.  Thanks to character customization, the gameplay will be much more pleasant for you, and the various stories of our NPCs will trigger positive emotions.

To achieve this, we decided to enrich the game with UI that allows you to change many aspects of our protagonist: change the color of the hair, body or eyes, but also change details such as clothes!
[previewyoutube=pNUsPNmYVdM;full][/previewyoutube]
At your disposal there will be colorful caps, hairstyles, shirts and pants kept in mainly Chinese style.

As always, we are open to all your suggestions, if you want to contact us directly, you can do it on a dedicated Discord server, also you can find [b]exclusive content[/b] there and know about the latest information in advance 😎 Just click the link below 👇
[url=https://discord.gg/ujMc55FHqY][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39325127/f6606ef86362d4c3188439d9b23bef12e3c2b56c.png[/img][/url]

notes.title: WELCOME PLAYERS
notes.content:
[h2][b]⛩️ Welcome to DAOMEI VILLAGE! ⛩️[/b][/h2]

We would like to invite you to the unique world of Chinese history and folklore. Let yourself be carried away by the extraordinary culture, magic and secrets of Daomei Village. Did you sneeze in front of the Emperor? Did you ruin his favorite robes? Don't feel special - everyone has something on their conscience here. It is a village of real unlucky people whom you have joined through a series of unfortunate events.

Solve the puzzles of village management, make friends, restore the settlement to its original splendor and you will be rewarded. Perhaps. Unless you do something wrong again.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41839711/d8d83da611a812cd15294fdead4cd14b248ec05b.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41839711/7842c2edbd3cf4906905561a6597d5fa07762c48.png[/img]

Our game is at an early stage of production, however the entire trailer that you can watch on Steam has been fully developed on the game engine. We count on your suggestions and ideas for the game, what would you like to see in our game? Write in the comments section or join our Discord community 👇
